description: This file contains implementation of bucketization and searchsorted operations optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend, including kernel dispatching and utility functions within PyTorch’s ATen library for MPS.

methods.name: searchsorted_mps_contiguous
methods.description: Performs a searchsorted operation on contiguous tensors using Metal Performance Shaders, dispatching GPU kernels with specific parameters.

methods.name: searchsorted_out_mps
methods.description: Outputs the result of a searchsorted operation to a provided tensor, handling contiguous and non-contiguous tensors.

methods.name: searchsorted_mps
methods.description: High-level function to perform searchsorted operation, returning the result tensor.

methods.name: bucketize_out_mps
methods.description: Performs bucketization (digitizing values into bins) and outputs to the provided tensor.

methods.name: bucketize_mps
methods.description: Performs bucketization (digitizing values into bins) and returns the result tensor.
